note: The runtime Market OS redistributes. This file is the authority; process.execPath is not. A build may consume a locally supplied node.exe only when its bytes hash to binary.sha256, and that hash is not asserted here on its own — it is the entry for binary.upstreamPath in the committed SHASUMS256.txt beside this file, which is the Node.js project's own release manifest. A same-major runtime from anywhere else fails.

license.note: The complete Node.js licence and its third-party notices, as published at tag v24.14.0. Redistributing the binary without this text is the defect this file exists to close.

upstream.acquisitionNote: SHASUMS256.txt and LICENSE were read once from the addresses above to create this pin and committed here. The BUILD performs no network access: it reads only these committed files and the local binary it is given.
